newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa gains on grind, but upside seen limited.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa gains on grind, but upside seen limited.

text.p: Surprising increases in European cocoa production last quarter may give New York cocoa prices a boost in the near-term, but analysts said the gains are likely to be limited.

Cocoa grindings -- a key barometer of consumption -- shot up by 42 percent in the U.K. in the third quarter 1996 versus the same period last year, to 48,855 tonnes. Industry analysts had expected an increase of up to 20 percent.
